nativeBehavior: The template invokes the infobox module entry point.
parseDataParameters preprocesses dados with dependent rótulo in an initial block of fifty numbered slots.
renderRows assigns rótuloN to the row label and dadosN to the displayed data.
Rows outside the initial block depend on source continuity across later preprocessing blocks.
toolBoundary: Only existing unique nonblank literal rótuloN/dadosN pairs for N from 1 to 50 may waive the opaque owner for the exact fresh chemical stage. This is a conservative tool limit, not a claim that the native template cannot render higher rows.
mutationBoundary: Only the existing source-bound opening-brace entity or raw-token line-wrapping transformation is eligible. Names, chemical characters, field relationships and all unrelated source bytes stay unchanged.
